question: By 2031-12-31, will this resolve true: Agent authority rails become the transaction network after AI.
resolution_metric: Count of payment, identity, or cloud platforms operating agent credential networks; transaction volume through agent-specific credentials; procurement or regulatory text requiring agent identity and delegated authority for high-value actions.
kill_condition: Kill if by 2031 agents still transact at scale through ordinary user credentials, API keys, or human-initiated payment flows with no separate agent identity, permission, or liability layer.
source_board: The World After AI: intelligence gets permission to act

question: By 2031-12-31, will this resolve true: Liability moves to the evidence recorder.

kill_condition: Kill if by 2031 serious AI incidents are still litigated mainly through ordinary negligence discovery and logs remain voluntary internal telemetry with no sector-specific effect on insurance, legal defense, or market access.

question: By 2031-12-31, will this resolve true: Autonomous labs bottleneck on standards before autonomy.

kill_condition: Kill if by 2031 major autonomous-lab deployments remain dominated by bespoke vendor stacks with no named protocol, sample, data, or instrument standards required in public procurements or industrial contracts.

question: By 2035-12-31, will this resolve true: Materials discovery becomes a qualification-data business.

kill_condition: Kill if by 2035 three or more AI-discovered materials reach high-volume design-in within 36 months of disclosure without public qualification delays or shared qualification-data businesses becoming material.

question: By 2033-12-31, will this resolve true: Human causal perturbation atlases become the drug-discovery scarce asset.
resolution_metric: Top-20 pharma or mega-biotech deals above $500 million that explicitly center proprietary human perturbation, spatial, or organoid atlases; FDA or EMA approval packages citing such platforms as material mechanism or pharmacology evidence.
kill_condition: Kill if by 2033 fewer than two such major deals are disclosed and approval packages continue relying on conventional animal and in-vitro evidence without atlas-derived human causal evidence.

question: By 2033-12-31, will this resolve true: Grid stability replaces megawatts as the AI load gate.
resolution_metric: Number of US RTO/ISO regions or NERC/FERC-linked reliability processes requiring large data-center loads to provide dynamic load models and ride-through or grid-support commitments; GW of AI-campus capacity publicly using BESS, grid-forming inverter, or MVDC front ends as interconnection enablers.
kill_condition: Kill if by 2033 grid operators integrate large AI loads through ordinary substation and capacity studies with no special dynamic-load, EMT-model, ride-through, or grid-support requirements.

question: By 2032-12-31, will this resolve true: AI campuses become heat-sink and water-rights assets.
resolution_metric: Number of OECD jurisdictions requiring new large data centers to reuse material waste heat, use non-potable or closed-loop cooling, or prove infeasibility; share of AI-campus announcements citing heat sink, WUE, reclaimed water, or district-heat offtake as a siting reason.
kill_condition: Kill if by 2032 rules remain disclosure-only and hyperscale AI campuses continue scaling in water- and heat-stressed regions without heat or water constraints materially changing site selection.
